task_name: Replication and Support-Budget Sensitivity of the Sole APC-over-Exhaustive Cell
decision_rationale: Across intact bundles 1-4 and 20 data seeds, increasing support budget to N=256 closes candidate mis-selection. At N=256, mean exhaustive EM across bundles is [1.0, 0.9689, 0.9955, 0.9129] with mean oracle-baseline gap Delta = 0.0007. Zero bundles exhibit Oracle >= 0.95 with Exhaustive < 0.95. The isolated NRQ-006 seed-101 finding (Oracle 0.96 vs Exh 0.88 on N=32) is conclusively closed as a finite-sample / support-mis-selection artifact under small sample budget.
